rationale: Same-field retrieval is needed because the core problem remains anchored in superheavy-element synthesis, nuclear stability, recoil handling, and discovery criteria. Cross-domain retrieval is also justified because key bottlenecks—few-atom evidence, rapid single-atom transport, uncertainty-quantified extrapolation, and robust atomic-number assignment—may benefit from mechanism transfer from rare-event detection, trace analysis, Bayesian experimental design, or rapid micro-scale chemical handling.
